name: Banja Luka Cube Day 2024

venue.name: Osnovna Škola ,,Dositej Obradović"
venue.address: Mirka Kovačevića 27, Banja Luka, Republika Srpska, Bosna i Hercegovina

information: This is the 13th WCA competition in Bosnia and Herzegovina. The competition is open to all persons from all countries. All competitors who place in the top 3 of an event will be awarded certificates. ================ Ovo je 13. WCA takmičenje u Bosni i Hercegovini. Takmičenje je otvoreno za sve osobe iz svih zemalja. Za sve takmičare u prva 3 mjesta biće dodeljeni sertifikati.
